sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court and High Court Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 2018
ACT X OF 2018
SUPREME COURT AND HIGH COURT (EXTENSION OF JURISDICTION TO
FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED
TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 2018
An Act to extend the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
of Pakistan and the Peshawar High Court to the
Federally Administered Tribal Areas
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
21st April, 2018]
No. F.
9(1)/2018-Legis, dated 20.4.2018.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 17th
April, 2018 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Pakistan and the
Peshawar High Court to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Supreme Court and High
Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act,
2018.
(2) It shall come
into force on such date or dates and in such Federally Administered Tribal
Areas or part thereof, as the Federal Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, determine from time to time.

Extension of jurisdiction of Supreme Court

ACT X OF 2018
ACT X OF 2018
SUPREME COURT AND HIGH COURT (EXTENSION OF JURISDICTION TO
FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED
TRIBAL AREAS) ACT, 2018
An Act to extend the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
of Pakistan and the Peshawar High Court to the
Federally Administered Tribal Areas
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
21st April, 2018]
No. F.
9(1)/2018-Legis, dated 20.4.2018.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 17th
April, 2018 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Pakistan and the
Peshawar High Court to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Extension of
jurisdiction of Supreme Court.---The Supreme Court of
Pakistan shall have, in relation to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas,
the same jurisdiction as it has in relation to the province of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa.
